programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard. The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Kang Baek-soo also known as the “fairy of literature and music”! Kang Baek-soo made his debut as a musician in 2010 with the EP “Songs Cross the River.” Since then he has touched the hearts of countless listeners with his heartfelt and witty music including “Time Machine” “Because of Ha Heon-jae” “Ulsan” and more. Prior to his debut as a musician he won the Rookie Award at the quarterly journal “Poetry and the World” in 2008 and pursued his career as a writer as well proving that he is the “real” fairy of literature and music. In this episode Kang Baek-soo performs “Time Machine” “I Want To Go Home” “Garcia” “Ulsan” and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet Kang Baek-soo!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Composed of vocalist Joo Sung-geun and guitarist Oh Ji-hyun this band made their debut in April 2017 with the EP “DEAR : X.” Then they performed all the songs in their debut EP in Seoul Forest in the form of busking to engrave their name in the minds of the public. Thanks to their hard work and stunning musicality they won the Gold Prize at the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie with the lead single off the debut EP “Draw the Line.” In December last year the duo released their third EP “naps!” to comfort our souls. Also the two have been participating in various soundtracks from TV series to variety shows to adverts actively expanding their reach in the entertainment industry. In this episode 1415 performs “Draw the Line” “I Am Blue” “SURFER” “naps!” and more to show off their artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: For many eSNa might not be the first musician that comes to mind when thinking of Korean pop music. However she's actually a big name in the music scene with numerous hit songs under her belt. The list includes “Some” by SoYou and Junggigo “Without You” by Mad Clown “Piano Man” and “AHH OOP” by MAMAMOO and more. In 2014 she made her debut as a singer as well with the song “I I Love You“ and has participated in various soundtracks for TV series since then including ”The Heirs“ and ”Hogu's Love.“ In January this year this talented artist kicked off a remake project called “Nostalgia Project” which is an English version of Korean pop masterpieces that were released before K-pop became an international sensation. Backed up with her outstanding musicality and creative ideas which gave her success as a composer and lyricist eSNa is making her mark as a singer as well. In this episode eSNa performs “Some” “A Little Lovin” “Love Forgotten By Love” from “Nostalgia Project” and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is acoustic musician Bily Acoustie! This artist made his debut in 2013 with the single “For A Rest.” With his trademark acoustic heartwarming sounds he won various awards at major music festivals and also quickly engraved his name in the minds of the public. That's not all thanks to his outstanding talent as a guitarist he has worked with numerous A-list musicians including Shim Soo-bong Byun Jin-seob OKDAL (also known as Rooftop Moonlight) JYJ and more creating his own genre called “Bily Acoustie.” In this episode this musician performs “One Ordinary Winter” “Days of Disturbance” “How I Love You” and more to showcase the quintessence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet Bily Acoustie!

The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. programme.desc: Escape daily stress with this video showcasing breathtaking natural landscapes. Relax to soothing piano music and nature sounds, from waterfalls and mountains to serene beaches and fjords.

programme.title: time2Rlx Wildlife
programme.desc: Explore Botswana's wild landscapes, witnessing lions, giraffes, elephants, and vibrant birdlife in Chobe National Park, and experience thrilling hunts and the beauty of Africa's nature.

programme.title: time2Rlx Water
programme.desc: Relax with the soothing sounds of underwater life and explore the stunning world of the Egyptian Red Sea. Discover vibrant coral reefs, exotic fish, and marine creatures in this peaceful video, ideal for stress relief and relaxation.

programme.title: In tempo per Natale
programme.desc: Lina e Max, ex compagni di scuola, stanno tornando nella loro città per Natale quando una bufera di neve sconvolge il viaggio. Costretti a proseguire insieme, scoprono che il passato potrebbe avere ancora qualcosa da dire.

programme.title: Le vacanze di Natale
programme.desc: Una preside cerca di salvare la scuola dalla chiusura e chiede aiuto a una vecchia conoscenza diventata star di Hollywood, riscoprendo con lui sentimenti mai davvero dimenticati.

programme.title: La cura del Natale
programme.desc: Una dottoressa torna a casa per Natale e scopre che il padre vuole andare in pensione. Il ritorno di un vecchio amore la costringe a ripensare al proprio futuro.

programme.title: Un Natale da scoprire
programme.desc: Un imprevisto matrimonio della vigilia costringe una donna a trascorrere il Natale nella campagna inglese, dove la collaborazione con un uomo del posto si trasforma in qualcosa di più.

programme.title: Un Casanova a Natale
programme.desc: Una podcaster aiuta un uomo a conquistare la sua cotta d'infanzia creando per lui il Natale perfetto, ma durante il percorso tra i due nasce un sentimento inatteso.

programme.title: La sfilata di Natale
programme.desc: Kristin Cooper, assistente carina e talentuosa di un'importante agenzia di PR, deve organizzare l'annuale sfilata e la relativa asta di Natale per un imprenditore tessile, il sig. Carson.

programme.title: A Christmas Reunion
programme.desc: Un'affermata professionista del settore pubblicitario torna nella sua città natale dopo la morte della zia, il cui ultimo desiderio era che la nipote riaprisse la sua panetteria e ospitasse il 50° concorso di cucina di Natale annuale.

programme.title: George Balanchine lo schiaccianoci
programme.desc: La vigilia di Natale, Clara vuole rimanere sveglia per giocare con la sua bambola Schiaccianoci, ma deve andare a letto. Quando tutti vanno in pensione, scende di nascosto al piano di sotto per stare con la sua bambola, si addormenta e sogna una magica avventura.

programme.title: Natale, è sempre Natale!
programme.desc: Haylie Duff interpreta Eve, un'organizzatrice di feste che deve decidere se occuparsi di un evento dell'ultimo minuto oppure partire per una vacanza romantica. Dal momento che si ritroverà a sperimentare entrambe le prospettive, quale sarà la sua decisione?

programme.title: 100 volte Natale
programme.desc: Un adolescente rivive magicamente il giorno di Natale all'infinito e usa questo sortilegio per fare un regalo speciale alla sua famiglia.

programme.title: 7 uomini d'oro
programme.desc: Una meticolosa e geniale rapina viene commessa ai danni di una banca svizzera per opera di un gruppo di abilissimi malviventi.

programme.title: Allegri becchini... Arriva Trinità
programme.desc: Un gruppo di banditi, capeggiati da uno spietato uomo incappucciato, rapisce e uccide una giovane donna. Quando il fratello della vittima, Django Randall, detto la "Trinità del West" fa ritorno in paese, ha subito inizio un regolamento di conti senza esclusione di colpi.

programme.title: Lovers
programme.desc: Lovers, il film italiano pluripremiato all'estero, affronta in maniera simmetrica quattro storie che coinvolgono gli stessi cinque protagonisti in ruoli diversi, chiusi in una spirale di tradimenti, feroci vendette, colpi di scena e una riflessione sull'importanza della cultura. Un film in cui amore, commedia, dubbio, sospetto e omicidio rappresentano le costanti della storia come della vita.

programme.title: La verità vi prego sull'amore
programme.desc: Un gruppo di amici affronta amori, gelosie, tradimenti e paure mentre cerca di capire cosa significhi davvero costruire una relazione. Tra ironia e disillusione, ognuno deve fare i conti con le proprie scelte sentimentali.

programme.title: Il Monaco di Monza
programme.desc: Nel Seicento, il povero ciabattino Pasquale e l'amico Mamozio si travestono da frati per sfamare dodici bambini. Al castello di una marchesa finiscono però coinvolti in intrighi, matrimoni forzati e mille equivoci.

programme.title: Le motorizzate
programme.desc: Cinque episodi raccontano con ironia il rapporto tra donne, automobili e vita quotidiana nell'Italia del boom economico. Tra suore spericolate, automobiliste, truffe, equivoci e improbabili vigili urbani, una commedia corale che mette in scena vizi e ossessioni dell'Italia su quattro ruote.

programme.title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
programme.desc: Il celebre Alberto Sordi in una divertentissima commedia. Rosario Scimoni, detto Sasà, è una persona opportunista e senza scrupoli, nipote del sindaco di Catania, sempre pronto a schierarsi con chiunque possa aiutarlo. Passa dal socialismo al fascismo, cambiando fede politica con la stessa facilità con cui cambia le donne. Prova addirittura a fondare un proprio partito. Diretto da Luigi Zampa.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi, Nino Manfredi e Ugo Tognazzi in una divertente commedia composta da tre episodi. Un timido impiegato riesce a dichiarare le sue intenzioni sentimentali a una collega un alto funzionario cerca di far sparire le tracce di un filmato compromettente un partecipante a un concorso, dotato di una brutta dentatura, mette in crisi i tentativi di boicottaggio da parte della commissione.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Giorni d'amore
programme.desc: Due giovani paesani, Angela e Pasquale, dovrebbero sposarsi, ma non hanno i mezzi per affrontare le spese delle nozze. La soluzione suggerita dai genitori è: se Pasquale rapisse Angela, la ragazza sarebbe compromessa e s`imporrebbe il classico matrimonio riparatore, al quale non si addice nesusna fastosa cerimonia...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: La donna del giorno
programme.desc: Una giovane donna cerca di farsi strada nel mondo del lavoro e della vita sociale, ma si trova coinvolta in una relazione complicata con un uomo di potere che la sfrutta e la manipola per i propri fini.

programme.title: Oltre le Colline
programme.desc: Alina torna dalla Germania per prendere Voichita, l'unica persona che abbia mai amato e che mai amerà. Ma Voichita ha incontrato Dio e in amore, è molto difficile avere Dio come rivale.

programme.title: Cacciatore di teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: The Old Man and The Gun
programme.desc: La storia vera della fuga dal carcere del settantenne Forrest Tucker, della successiva fuga dal detective Hunt e della sua storia d'amore.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: Il fotografo ventiseienne Dennis Stock è molto più maturo dei suoi anni e ancora legato alla vita familiare quando nel 1955 riceve il compito di fotografare per il magazine Life l'astro nascente James Dean, uno spirito libero destinato a divenire un idolo e a cambiare per sempre la cultura popolare. L'assegnazione del servizio porterà Dennis e James ad affrontare un viaggio per gli States, che plasmerà Stock e consegnerà alla storia alcune delle immagini più iconiche del periodo.

programme.title: UN NATALE DA SCOPRIRE
programme.desc: Il Natale nella campagna inglese non era nei piani di Emma fino a quando sua sorella Amy non ha deciso di organizzare il suo matrimonio per la vigilia di Natale. Dylan, il socio di Amy nel mercatino di Natale, collabora con Emma per mettere ordine nel caos dei preparativi.

programme.title: LE 12 SFIDE PER NATALE
programme.desc: La tranquilla stagione festiva di un'insegnante subisce una scossa quando accetta la sfida delle 12 prove di Natale lanciata dalla sorella, mentre si affretta a preparare la sua città per un programma di scambio natalizio con un affabile e supponente insegnante di francese.

programme.title: UN NATALE VERO E SINCERO
programme.desc: Un magico desiderio natalizio dona a un organizzatore di eventi la capacità di ascoltare ciò che tutti desiderano per le festività.

programme.title: COME IN UN FILM DI NATALE
programme.desc: Alla vigilia di una scadenza importante, una cinica maniaca del lavoro rimane bloccata in una piccola città del Colorado a causa di un guasto alle luci natalizie. Si ritrova così a recitare il ruolo di protagonista in un film natalizio in stile Hallmark.

programme.title: UN TOCCO DI CREATIVITÀ A NATALE
programme.desc: Harper, un'aspirante illustratrice, sta collaborando con Caleb, un autore di libri molto esigente. Quando lui insiste affinché lei lavori durante il periodo natalizio in una pittoresca cittadina, lei deve sfruttare i festeggiamenti natalizi della città per aiutarlo a superare il suo blocco dello scrittore.

programme.title: Accadde al commissariato
programme.desc: Un commissario ha appena comprato un'auto, ma non riesce a mostrarla alla moglie perché nel suo ufficio continuano a entrare persone: due sposini, un giovane sfruttatore, una compagnia di riviste derubata, un uomo che indossa una gonna.

programme.title: LErba Di Grace
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare la sua proprietà, Grace, una vedova inglese, decide di collaborare con un giardiniere e trasformare la serra di orchidee in una coltivazione di marijuana.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Candidatura agli Oscar per Ryan Gosling. Dan è un insegnante di scuola pubblica, brillante e capace di motivare i suoi allievi nonostante le difficoltà della vita di periferia. Nel privato però affoga i suoi tormenti nell'abuso di alcool e droghe.

programme.title: Fuga Da Pretoria
programme.desc: Arrestati per aver partecipato ad operazioni segrete per conto dell'African National Congress di Nelson Mandela, due attivisti sudafricani cercano di inviare un messaggio al regime dell'apartheid e fuggire dalla famigerata prigione di Pretoria.

programme.title: Dragged Across Concrete: Poliziotti al limite
programme.desc: C'è un poliziotto di lunga esperienza di nome Ridgeman e c'è il suo partner più giovane, più goloso e chiacchierone: Anthony. Durante l'arresto di uno spacciatore latinoamericano, i due ci vanno giù poco leggeri e vengono ripresi dalla videocamera di un vicino indignato e sbattuti al telegiornale.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Fong è un ladro che ha il vizio del gioco. L'occasione per fare un po' di soldi si presenta quando un magnate gli offre l'incarico di rapire un bambino. L'uomo accetta, ma l'unico problema è che deve prendersi cura del piccolo per qualche giorno.

programme.title: La battaglia degli imperi
programme.desc: 48 a. C. La Via della Seta è luogo di passaggio e di contesa tra popoli differenti per etnia e costumi. Il generale Huo An, un unno adottato e cresciuto da un generale cinese, è il custode della pace e del delicato equilibrio tra le 36 nazioni.

programme.title: La Famiglia Fang
programme.desc: Caleb e Camille Fang sono performer le cui creazioni scioccano il pubblico e deliziano gli appassionati d'arte. Protagonisti sin dalla più tenera età sono i loro figli, pedine fondamentali delle loro opere provocatorie spesso al limite tra il genio e la follia.

programme.title: Broken
programme.desc: Una giovane donna fugge dal suo passato e fugge in Inghilterra in cerca di una nuova vita. Accetta un lavoro per prendersi cura di un tetraplegico, ma il peso del lavoro agita il suo passato. Sembra che i limiti della cura non siano sempre così chiari come dovrebbero essere

programme.title: Crucifixion
programme.desc: Padre Dumitru e alcune suore compiono un violento esorcismo su suor Adelina, che si crede posseduta da un demone. A seguito della morte di quest'ultima, i suoi aguzzini vengono arrestati con l'accusa di omicidio. Nella capitale giunge Nicole, giornalista newyorchese, che vuole indagare sul caso.

programme.title: La baia di Eva
programme.desc: Nel caldo sud della Louisiana degli anni ‘60, la giovane Eve Batiste scopre gli oscuri segreti della sua famiglia benestante. Dopo aver assistito a un tradimento del padre, il carismatico dottor Louis Batiste, la sua innocenza si sgretola tra verità scomode e superstizioni. Un dramma avvolto da mistero e magia, dove il confine tra ricordi e realtà si fa sempre più labile.

programme.title: Daybreakers L'ultimo vampiro
programme.desc: Un'epidemia ha trasformato quasi tutti gli umani in vampiri, costringendo i pochi superstiti a nascondersi. Edward Dalton, un vampiro che rifiuta il sangue umano, lavora per creare un'alternativa sintetica e salvare l'umanità con l'aiuto della sopravvissuta Audrey.

programme.title: Amore alla moda
programme.desc: Quando Allie lascia la sua piccola città per trasferirsi a San Francisco ed inseguire il suo sogno di diventare stilista, non immagina neanche lontanamente che la città abbia in serbo grandi progetti per lei e per il suo cuore.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere su una rubrica anonima di consigli d'amore. Lì incontra il caporedattore Morgan Cooper. Tra i due scocca subito la scintilla. Sarà proprio Audrey ad essere la nuova protagonista di una delle storie d'amore di cui scrive?

programme.title: Indovina chi
programme.desc: Theresa, una ragazza, porta il suo fidanzato, Simon, a casa per presentarlo ai suoi genitori e annunciare che si sono fidanzati. C'è un'altra sorpresa: Simon è bianco.

programme.title: The Psycho She Met Online
programme.desc: Quando il paramedico Karen arriva sulla scena di un grave incidente stradale, rimane sbalordita dal fatto che uno dei conducenti è suo marito. Nelle settimane successive dovrà prendersi cura di lui ed entrambi resteranno senza lavoro per qualche tempo. Quindi, decidono di affittare due stanze della loro casa per sbarcare il lunario... Quello che non avevano previsto è che uno dei loro inquilini sia la psicotica Miranda, la sorella che Karen non sapeva di avere...

programme.title: My Old Lady
programme.desc: Mathias Gold, un giramondo newyorkese, si reca a Parigi per liquidare un lussuoso appartamento ereditato dal padre. Una volta a Parigi, Mathias scopre che nel suo appartamento risiede un'anziana signora di nome Mathilde insieme alla figlia Chloé.

programme.title: Per te, con amore
programme.desc: La proprietaria di un'attività di abiti da sposa di seconda mano dà nuova vita agli abiti usati, realizzando i sogni delle spose che non possono permettersi un vestito costoso. Ma quando incontra l'uomo perfetto, ha paura di dare al proprio cuore una seconda possibilità.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Layla Bennet conduce il programma mattutino Wake Up Chicago! con il suo affascinante collega Derek Dray. Non vanno sempre d'accordo e quando improvvisamente devono prendersi cura di un bambino insieme, il loro incubo peggiore diventa realtà!

programme.title: Le pagine della mia vita
programme.desc: Quando Lisa torna nella sua città natale per cercare ispirazione per la sua nuova linea di moda, si ritrova ad aiutare la sua migliore amica a prepararsi alla nascita del primo figlio.

programme.title: Due cuori e una tenda
programme.desc: Durante un'inaspettata vacanza in campeggio organizzata all'ultimo minuto, due perfetti sconosciuti si ritrovano a condividere la stessa tenda per errore. Tra disastri comici, notti sotto le stelle e momenti inaspettatamente teneri, scoprono che forse l'amore si nasconde nei luoghi più improbabili.

programme.title: Un padre in prestito
programme.desc: Per poter adottare un ragazzo problematico, un impiegato postale solitario e non sposato deve dimostrare di essere emotivamente qualificato per amare e accudire un bambino.

programme.title: Women Talking
programme.desc: "Women Talking - Il diritto di scegliere" segue un gruppo di donne di un'isolata comunità religiosa mentre cercano di capire come costruire un mondo migliore per sé e i propri figli. Resta e combatti, o scappa. Non resteranno ferme a guardare.

programme.title: La donna del tenente francese
programme.desc: Candidato a cinque premi Oscar (tra cui quello alla migliore attrice per Meryl Streep), questo capolavoro vanta nel suo cast anche Jeremy Irons, in una delle storie d'amore di più forte impatto visivo mai portate sullo schermo.

programme.title: Voglia di ricominciare
programme.desc: La commovente storia di formazione del rapporto violento tra un ragazzo, il suo nuovo patrigno e la sua terrorizzata madre.

programme.title: Batti Cuore
programme.desc: La podcaster Samantha Desouza è incaricata di ospitare uno show per riunire gli amori perduti. Anche se l'amore è l'ultima cosa nella sua mente, Samantha si innamora dell'affascinante Jake. Questa volta Samantha seguirà il suo cuore?

programme.title: Amarsi sotto la pioggia
programme.desc: Casey decide di rispettare le ultime volontà di sua madre e si reca a Londra per consegnare una lettera a Lord Benton. La donna si innamora del figlio del nobile britannico, Micheal.

programme.title: La squadra di Natale
programme.desc: Allie, un'insegnante d'arte disoccupata, deve accettare un lavoro con la Santa Squad per aiutare un ricco vedovo e le sue due preziose figlie a riscoprire la magia del Natale. Mentre Allie solleva lo spirito natalizio della famiglia con decorazioni natalizie, biscotti e shopping, la sua gentilezza viene ricompensata con il regalo più inaspettato: l'amore!

programme.title: Lamore non basta
programme.desc: Martina è un'assistente di volo. Durante un volo conosce Angelo, un ragazzo timido e introverso che come lei vive in un piccolo paese dell'Abruzzo. Scopriranno invece di conoscersi da molto tempo.

programme.title: The Congress
programme.desc: Robin Wright, una ormai stanca e invecchiata diva hollywoodiana, accetta un ultimo ruolo offertole dalla major Miramount, che le propone di comprare la sua identità cinematografica: attraverso un body scanner verrà creato un alias a sua immagine da utilizzare sullo schermo al posto suo, rendendola così protagonista di tutti i film che in passato lei stessa aveva rifiutato. In cambio Robin riceverà un'ingente somma di denaro e gli studios le promettono di mantenere il suo personaggio giovane per l'eternità.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Te
programme.desc: La trentenne Daphe ha appena chiuso una relazione. A una festa incontra due uomini affascinanti e opposti: con entrambi avvia una relazione.

programme.title: Mrs. Mills
programme.desc: Helene possiede un appartamento chic nel centro di Parigi, pubblica romanzi romanticamente kitsch e conduce una vita completamente dettata dal lavoro. Tutto il suo amore è per i libri. Ma la sua vita quotidiana viene stravolta quando la signora Mills, un'eccentrica signora americana, si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto.

programme.title: La Sorgente dell'Amore
programme.desc: Leila, giovane sposa magrebina, propone alle donne del suo villaggio di fare lo sciopero dell'amore: niente più sesso finché gli uomini non porteranno l'acqua al villaggio. E alla fine le donne la spunteranno.

programme.title: Ladre per caso
programme.desc: L'introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune solo il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato ovunque. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari», Patrick chiederà aiuto alle due figlie, tentando di recuperare il tempo perduto.

programme.title: Parlami Di Te
programme.desc: Alain è un uomo d'affari che non concede alcuno spazio alle distrazioni e alla famiglia. Viene colpito da un ictus, che gli lascia una grave difficoltà nell'espressione verbale e una perdita della memoria. Si affida a una giovane logopedista.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: As Good as It Gets
programme.desc: Melvin odia le donne, i gay ed è pieno di manie. Ma qualcosa è destinato a cambiare. C'era una volta, un misogino, ossessionato da una serie infinita di complessi e manie e dotato di una lingua avvelenata. Ma dopo l'incontro con un cane e con una bella cameriera, qualcosa cambia e l'orco si rivela un burbero benefico.

programme.title: L'Arte di Vincere
programme.desc: Dopo aver giocato per molti anni tra le fila degli Oakland Athletics, Billy Beane (Brad Pitt) diviene il general manager della squadra di baseball che al momento langue economicamente. Intenzionato al raggiungere il miglior risultato con la minor spesa possibile, l'uomo elabora un rivoluzionario metodo per scegliere i giocatori da acquistare e inserire nella rosa da schierare in campo. Attraverso il ricorso a modelli matematici e statistici e l'aiuto di Peter Brand (Jonah Hill), Billy in poco tempo rivoluzionerà il modo del baseball, nonostante la diffidenza di chi lo ha preceduto e il timore di chi lo circonda.

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Furto di sera bel colpo si spera
programme.desc: Quinto, ladro sfortunato, passa dalle auto ai salumi e ai quadri, finendo sempre in ospedale o in galera

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Rebelles
programme.desc: Sandra è una giovane donna costretta a lasciare il sud della Francia per fuggire da un marito violento. Senza nessuno, è tornata a Boulogne-sur-Mer, la città della sua infanzia che ha lasciato quasi 15 anni fa. Trova sua madre lì e un mondo che ha lasciato dietro di sé.

programme.title: Genitori quasi perfetti
programme.desc: La prossima volta che vuoi organizzare una festa di compleanno a tuo figlio, pensaci!

programme.title: Babysitting
programme.desc: Franck deve fare da babysitter a Remy, il figlio del suo capo Marc, proprio giorno del suo compleanno. Non rinuncia però a festeggiare con gli amici nella villa di Marc. Il mattino dopo la polizia informa Marc che Franck e Rémy sono scomparsi... ma una videocamera ha ripreso la notte brava!

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: In questa commedia esilarante Valentín è un playboy di Acapulco che vive una vita eccentrica e senza responsabilità. Un giorno sulla sua porta si presenta Julie, una sua ex scappatella che gli lascia la figlia stravolgendogli la vita.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato inventa una macchina che agisce sui geni e trasforma il nipote di quattro anni in un adulto. Quando Bobby scappa di casa, i suoi fratelli devono riuscire a trovarlo prima del ritorno dei genitori. Il tempo stringe, rimane un solo giorno!

programme.title: Il monaco di Monza
programme.desc: Italia, 1630. Totò è un ciabattino alle prese con la miseria e la fame, e padre di famiglia con dodici bambini a carico. Si finge frate assieme a Mamozio e insieme giungono al castello del perfido marchese Egidio de Lattanzis.

programme.title: Irma Vep
programme.desc: Un' attrice cinematografica Cinese, in Francia per recitare in un remake di "Les Vampires", trova futili intrighi e vanitosi scontri sul set.

programme.title: Beatrice Cenci
programme.desc: Bellissimo film storico sull'inchiesta della famiglia Cenci nella Roma di fine Cinquecento. La nobile famiglia Cenci è dominata dalla figura del padre Francesco (Gino Cervi), temuto per la sua crudeltà. Caccia dal castello Olimpo, l'innamorato della figlia, mentre il figlio ha un relazione con la matrigna. Scoperta la tresca, Francesco cerca di uccidere il figlio, ma le cose si complicano.

programme.title: Le baccanti
programme.desc: Splendido film storico di Giorgio Ferroni, con Taina Elg, Alberto Lupo e Alessandra Panaro. Per placare l'ira di Minerva, che ha asciugato i pozzi di Tebe, il re della città Penteo decide di compiere un sacrificio umano. Il re decide di consegnare una vergine agli dei per scongiurare la forte siccità. La fanciulla verrà difesa da Laedamo, che deciderà di sfidare il re in un grande duello.

programme.title: Barabba
programme.desc: Liberato al posto di Gesù, il brigante Barabba vive tormentato dal dubbio su chi fosse davvero l'uomo condannato alla croce.

programme.title: Maciste contro i cacciatori di teste
programme.desc: Maciste guida il suo popolo lontano da un'isola devastata dalle eruzioni vulcaniche. Il viaggio li conduce in una terra dominata da tribù in guerra, dove l'eroe dovrà affrontare guerrieri e cacciatori di teste per salvare i superstiti.

programme.title: Allegri becchini... arriva Trinità
programme.desc: Swanee governa un gruppo di banditi a cui viene affidato il compito di rapire una donna in una città vicina. Il primo tentativo fallisce in città le sparatorie provocano molti morti. Quando l'ex sceriffo Chad Randall (noto anche come Trinità) torna lì, trova sua sorella - lei era la donna - uccisa dai banditi.

programme.title: Il ponte dei senza paura
programme.desc: I montanari Jim Redfern e Mike Evans si dirigono nella Columbia Britannica canadese attraverso il Cariboo Trail con l'intenzione di allevare bestiame e cercare l'oro, ma invece trovano guai.

programme.title: I due violenti
programme.desc: Il sergente di polizia Robert Logan deve rintracciare Cassidy, un assassino evaso che afferma di essere innocente. Un tempo erano amici, e quando Logan lo ritrova, i due si ritrovano coinvolti insieme in una serie di pericolose avventure mentre cercano di scoprire la verità.

programme.title: Monta in sella!! Figlio di...
programme.desc: Dopo una rapina finita male, Sam rischia l'impiccagione. Suo fratello Dean contatta un ex esperto di esplosivi francese e la sua nipote pokerista per salvargli la vita con una rapina in banca. Ma il gruppo viene coinvolto in un'impresa più grande per il cieco collezionista Felipe, affrontando rivalità e inganni lungo la strada.

programme.title: Era Sam Wallash!... lo chiamavano... E Così Sia
programme.desc: Un bandito spietato uccide il proprietario di una taverna e, casualmente, anche il fratello di Sam Wallbush. Testimone degli omicidi, Sam giura vendetta e parte in cerca del colpevole, pronto a versare sangue per ottenere giustizia.

programme.title: Non toccare la donna bianca
programme.desc: La battaglia di Custer e la disfatta di Little Big Horn sono ambientate nella fossa delle Halles a Parigi.

programme.title: Queimada
programme.desc: Sull'isola di Queimada, un avventuriero incita una rivolta contro i portoghesi per l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.title: Lo credevano uno stinco di santo
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fuorilegge sono in cerca del tesoro nascosto di un vecchio prigioniero: solo uno lo troverà

programme.desc: Non solo country. Il documentario racconta la maestria di Cash e la sua capacità di spaziare tra i generi.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar
programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia del re del pop, Elvis Presley, fino alla sua improvvisa morte nel 1977.
